best_point_readout.method: Rank by realized return: target_pct/100 if target is hit by T+20, otherwise T+20 close / entry_open - 1.

candidate_definition.hard_gate: production_gate_mask applied at each lag signal row
candidate_definition.lag_signal: lag0..7 stock-tradable rows from parent cross, evaluated as independent cohorts
candidate_definition.suspension_handling: non-tradable rows do not consume lag or horizon windows

entry_definition.entry: next stock-tradable open after lag signal close
entry_definition.entry_day_high: excluded because newly bought A-share positions are not same-day sellable
entry_definition.target_hit: any high from T+1 through T+20 sellable stock-tradable days after entry reaches target_price

limitations: Adjusted current-vintage local bars and current-file survivorship remain limitations.
T+20 close fallback is user-defined for this study; fees, slippage, tax, sizing, stop loss, and fillability are not modeled.
This is descriptive research, not real P&L or a production rule.
No production selector behavior was changed.
